newsitem.title: USA: Chevron sees normal US Gulf output next week.
newsitem.headline: Chevron sees normal US Gulf output next week.

text.p: Chevron Corp said its oil and gas production in the U.S. Gulf is gradually returning to normal Friday, as Hurricane Danny passed by the southern coast of Louisiana without major damage to offshore facilities.

A Chevron spokesman said full production would resume next week. Currently, oil production is running at 10 percent of the normal 125,000 barrels per day (bpd) level, and gas output at 45 percent of the regular 1.2 mmcfd.
"We expect production back to normal next week," said spokesman Tom Garcia.
Chevron noted the storm was now tracking "dead on" for its 295,000 bpd Pascagoula, Mississippi refinery, which was shut earlier on Friday as a precaution.
